text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Next week is the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS is a Junior-tier GⅠ race.
It is held the week before Epiphaneia's goal,
the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll be there to watch, so count on me! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's like a whirlwind. Since the Asahi Hai FS wasn't
a target to begin with, watching it is
fine. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then,
at the end of afternoon training that day—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for everything today too!
Great work!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
The logo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of where Epiphaneia had dashed off to,
there stood an Umamusume. She was—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Epi-san's Trainer.
Thank you for your hard work~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Logotype. A peer of Epiphaneia's,
an honest yet cheerful Umamusume.
Her personality is quite different from Epiphaneia's, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo, you were watching, weren't you! My training! I know you were!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I was watching~.
It was so glamorous, I couldn't take my eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
I knew you'd say that, Logo!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Well, it's true! You've been in the spotlight ever since your Debut, haven't you, Epi?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Flashiness really is
important too, huh~

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've got plenty of flair yourself!
You're dazzling, Logo!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I just know it!
You're definitely going to win the Asahi Hai FS!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
!
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Alright, as for me...
I guess I'll just keep doing what needs to be done~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Logotype isn't evaluated that highly at the moment. She probably senses that general atmosphere from the public as well.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! If you just execute everything you've worked on, you can win!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And—you have what it takes to "do it right." So everything will definitely be okay!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too!
At this point, you've got no choice but to believe in me!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
I'll definitely be there to watch you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...! I hear a voice!
I'm heading out now!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...There they go.
Man, they're always so full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Besides... you're very kind.
Even now, you're doing your best to encourage me when I'm so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: My emotions don't really show on my face...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Well, a GⅠ is a huge stage, after all.
It's only natural that you'd tense up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: "Still, thanks to you, I've completely relaxed~. ...Epi-san is always like this, though."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's okay! You can make it look perfect!
It's going to be a wonderful standing signboard!
The voice of destiny says so too!’"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
—Do you have some kind of sensor
that sniffs out people's sorrow and anxiety?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
When Epi-san is around, it brightens my heart.
...Trainer-san, do you know what I mean~?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my very best in the Asahi Hai FS.
Well then, I shall take my leave."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What kind of race will Logotype run—the one Epiphaneia holds in such high regard...? Let's watch the Asahi Hai FS to find out.
